title: Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load: Synchronization, Rule Execution and Misfires on the Background
abstract: arXiv:2611.27404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As the load grows, a language model makes more and more errors, but different processes stand behind this decline in quality. The model may lose the correspondence with the source text, it may keep its place in the text but execute a rule wrongly, or it may change a word that no rule concerns. In this work the degradation of a model under controlled load is separated into these three components: synchronization, rule execution and misfires. The load is set by rules that replace one word with another in a meaningless text, and each kind of load (the text length, the position of a word in the answer, the replacement density, the number of rules and the place of a rule in the list) is set separately. translated_title: 受控负载下语言模型的退化：同步、规则执行与背景误触发
translated_abstract: 随着负载的增长，语言模型会犯越来越多的错误，但这种质量下降背后存在不同的过程。模型可能失去与源文本的对应关系，可能保持在文本中的位置却错误地执行规则，也可能更改了没有任何规则涉及的词。在这项工作中，模型在受控负载下的退化被分解为这三个组成部分：同步、规则执行和误触发。负载由在无意义文本中将一个词替换为另一个词的规则来设定，并且每种负载（文本长度、词在答案中的位置、替换密度、规则数量以及规则在列表中的位置）都被单独设定。答案与参考答案的对齐使得追踪每个词的结果成为可能，而一个考虑到请求之间难度差异本身依赖于负载的统计模型，为每个……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将受控负载下语言模型的性能退化分解为同步失败、规则执行错误与无关误改三种成分，通过逐词对齐和考虑难度差异随负载变化的统计模型，独立量化文本长度、替换密度、规则数量等每种负载因素的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes language model degradation under controlled load into three components—synchronization loss, rule execution errors, and misfires—using word-replacement rules, word-level alignment tracking, and a statistical model that accounts for load-dependent difficulty spread, to isolate the effect of each load factor.
